changes.initial_review: Original TSS T-bit sets DR6 BT; new pending-event consumer also needs notification at exactly that original producer.
changes.counter_review: 16-bit TSS path sets T_byte=0; 32-bit task T-bit alone enters this branch. Keep architectural DR6 status and do not use sticky BT as recurring event. Later descriptor faults can intervene and c_cpu_continue cancels pending; this is not a claim of complete task-switch exception proof.
changes.limits: Source coupling verified; matcher fixture models consumption and does not exercise real TSS T-bit switching. No fresh runtime test.
changes.change_plan: Keep c_debug.h declaration and pending write coupled with c_main consumer and c_debug producers. Do not remove T-bit delivery or clear DR6 to suppress repeated traps.
changes.related_callers: Original task switch via c_tsksw; c_main normal instruction boundary; fault handlers through c_cpu_continue.
changes.verification_required: Real 32-bit TSS T-bit switch delivers one debug event; no T-bit and16-bit TSS controls; retained DR6 no repeat; subsequent new T-bit hit; descriptor/page fault during switch and reset cancellation. Existing matcher tests are supplemental only.
